title: Firmware version
passage:
Which firmware version should we install?
A. The installation is scheduled for Tuesday.
B. Use the one listed in the release note.
C. The update takes about ten minutes.
passageZh:

B. 使用發行說明列出的版本。
C. 更新大約要花十分鐘。
